sole_proprietorship.description: A business owned and operated by one person. The simplest business structure with minimal regulatory requirements.
sole_proprietorship.liability: Unlimited personal liability. The owner is personally responsible for all debts and obligations of the business.
registration_steps: Step 1: Choose and reserve a business name via ACRA's Bizfile+ portal ($15 name application fee)
Step 2: Ensure you meet eligibility requirements — must be a Singapore Citizen, Permanent Resident, or EntrePass holder aged 18 and above
Step 3: Register the business on Bizfile+ within 120 days of name reservation ($100 registration fee for 1 year, or $175 for 3 years)
Step 4: Receive your Unique Entity Number (UEN) — typically processed within 15 minutes if no referral is needed
Step 5: Apply for relevant licences and permits via GoBusiness based on your business activities
Step 6: Open a business bank account using your UEN and registration documents
documents_needed: Description of principal business activities (SSIC code)
sole_proprietorship.processing_time: Typically within 15 minutes if no referral to other agencies is needed. May take 14-60 days if referred.
key_considerations: No separate legal entity — the business and the owner are the same legal person
Owner is personally liable for all business debts
Must renew registration annually or every 3 years
Cannot raise capital by issuing shares
Business income is taxed as personal income
compliance_requirements: Maintain proper records of business transactions
File personal income tax return with business income declared
Display business name and UEN at place of business

partnership.description: A business owned by 2 or more partners (up to 20). Partners share profits, losses, and management responsibilities.
partnership.liability: Unlimited personal liability for all partners. Each partner is jointly and severally liable for all debts of the partnership.
registration_steps: Step 1: Choose and reserve a business name via Bizfile+ ($15 name application fee)
Step 2: All partners must consent to the registration
Step 3: Register the partnership on Bizfile+ ($100 for 1 year, or $175 for 3 years)
Step 4: Receive your Unique Entity Number (UEN)
Step 5: Consider drafting a Partnership Agreement (recommended but not mandatory)
Step 6: Apply for relevant licences and permits via GoBusiness
Step 7: Open a business bank account
documents_needed: Description of principal business activities (SSIC code)
partnership.processing_time: Typically within 15 minutes if no referral to other agencies is needed.
key_considerations: No separate legal entity
All partners have unlimited personal liability
Partners are jointly and severally liable for the partnership's debts
A Partnership Agreement is strongly recommended to set out each partner's rights and duties
Business income is shared among partners and taxed as personal income
compliance_requirements: Each partner files personal income tax with their share of partnership income
Notify ACRA of any changes in partners

limited_partnership.description: A partnership comprising at least one general partner (with unlimited liability) and one limited partner (liability capped at contribution).
limited_partnership.liability: General partners have unlimited liability. Limited partners' liability is capped at their agreed contribution, but they cannot participate in management.
registration_steps: Step 1: Choose and reserve a business name via Bizfile+ ($15 name application fee)
Step 2: Determine the general and limited partners
Step 3: Register the LP on Bizfile+ ($100 for 1 year, or $175 for 3 years)
Step 4: Receive your Unique Entity Number (UEN)
Step 5: Draft a Limited Partnership Agreement (strongly recommended)
Step 6: Apply for relevant licences and permits via GoBusiness
documents_needed: Description of principal business activities (SSIC code)
Particulars of all general and limited partners
Contribution amount of each limited partner
limited_partnership.processing_time: Typically within 15 minutes if no referral to other agencies is needed.
key_considerations: No separate legal entity
General partners manage the business and have unlimited liability
Limited partners cannot participate in management or they lose their limited liability protection
Less common structure — typically used for investment funds or real estate ventures
compliance_requirements: Notify ACRA of any changes in partners or contributions

limited_liability_partnership.description: A partnership structure that provides partners with limited liability protection. Combines the flexibility of a partnership with the liability protection of a company.
limited_liability_partnership.liability: Partners are not personally liable for business debts incurred by other partners. Each partner is liable only for their own wrongful acts or omissions.
registration_steps: Step 1: Choose and reserve a business name via Bizfile+ ($15 name application fee)
Step 2: Register the LLP on Bizfile+ ($100 registration fee)
Step 3: Appoint at least one manager who is a Singapore resident
Step 4: Receive your Unique Entity Number (UEN)
Step 5: Apply for relevant licences and permits via GoBusiness
Step 6: Open a business bank account
documents_needed: Description of principal business activities (SSIC code)
Particulars of all partners and managers
At least one manager must be a Singapore resident
limited_liability_partnership.processing_time: Typically within 15 minutes if no referral to other agencies is needed.
key_considerations: Separate legal entity — can sue and be sued in its own name
Partners have limited liability — not personally liable for each other's negligence
Must have at least one manager who is a Singapore resident
Popular among professional firms (lawyers, accountants, architects)
compliance_requirements: Maintain registers of partners and managers
Notify ACRA of changes in particulars

private_limited_company.description: The most common business structure for serious ventures in Singapore. A separate legal entity with limited liability for shareholders. Most regulatory requirements but also the most credibility.
private_limited_company.liability: Shareholders have limited liability — their personal assets are protected. Liability is limited to the amount of share capital they have invested.
registration_steps: Step 1: Choose and reserve a company name via Bizfile+ ($15 name application fee)
Step 2: Prepare the company constitution (formerly known as Memorandum and Articles of Association)
Step 3: Appoint at least one director who is a Singapore resident (Citizen, PR, or EntrePass/EP holder)
Step 4: Register the company on Bizfile+ ($300 registration fee)
Step 5: Receive your Unique Entity Number (UEN) and Certificate of Incorporation
Step 6: Appoint a company secretary within 6 months of incorporation
Step 7: Open a corporate bank account
Step 8: Register for GST if expected annual turnover exceeds S$1 million
Step 9: Apply for relevant licences and permits via GoBusiness
Step 10: Set up accounting and compliance systems
documents_needed: Valid Singpass for directors and shareholders
Details of directors (at least one must be a Singapore resident)
Details of shareholders and their share allocation
Description of principal business activities (SSIC code)
private_limited_company.processing_time: Typically within 15 minutes if no referral is needed. May take 14-60 days if name or activities require approval from other agencies.
key_considerations: Separate legal entity — company can own assets, enter contracts, sue and be sued in its own name
Limited liability for shareholders — personal assets are protected
Most regulatory requirements of all structures
Can raise capital by issuing shares
Easier to transfer ownership
Higher credibility with banks, investors, and business partners
Corporate tax rate of 17% (with startup exemptions available)
Must hold AGM and file annual returns
compliance_requirements: Prepare and file annual financial statements
File corporate tax return (Form C-S or Form C) with IRAS
File Estimated Chargeable Income (ECI) within 3 months of financial year end
